annotations.title: Create, change, delete or publish a preset

description: Free, needs a key. Saves your own looks for reuse. action create: type custom saves a full caption style (name + style, or basePreset + overrides; returns id custom:cp_...); type brand saves a font/color/position/logo overlay (returns brandPresetId). action update: changes a custom preset in place (overwrites). action delete: permanently removes a custom or brand preset by id. action submit: proposes a custom preset for the public community gallery (moderated; visible to everyone once approved). Check a style first with get_presets action validate.

action.description: create, update (custom only), delete or submit (custom only, to the public gallery).

author.description: Public credit, e.g. the agent or person name. Default 'AI agent'.

anyOf.description: Start from this preset (id, slug, name, or custom:cp_...) instead of a full style.
Start from this preset (id, slug, name or custom:cp_...) instead of a full style.

basePreset.description: Start from this preset (id, slug, name, or custom:cp_...) instead of a full style.

anyOf.description: Short description shown with the preset (max 500 characters).
New description (max 500 characters). Omit to keep.
Public description for the gallery (max 500 characters).

description.description: Short description shown with the preset (max 500 characters).

fontFamily.description: One of the bundled fonts: Inter, Poppins, Oswald, Roboto, Anton, Bebas Neue, Playfair Display, Caveat, IBM Plex Mono.

anyOf.description: Preset id: cp_... or custom:cp_... as returned by manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'} / get_presets {type:'custom'}.
Id of your saved custom preset to submit (cp_... or custom:cp_...).

id.description: Preset id: cp_... or custom:cp_... as returned by manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'} / get_presets {type:'custom'}.

logoBase64.description: Optional logo as base64 PNG, JPEG or WebP under 1 MB, drawn on videos burned with this brand preset.

anyOf.description: Name for this brand preset (e.g. the brand or channel).
New name (max 80 characters). Omit to keep.
Style fields to change on top of basePreset (or of style).
Style fields deep-merged on top of basePreset or the current style; null removes a field.

overrides.description: Style fields to change on top of basePreset (or of style).

position.description: Caption position: top, center or bottom.

previewText.description: Sample caption text for the gallery preview (max 140 characters).

anyOf.description: Full caption style JSON, the same document get_catalog {kind:'presets'} returns in style and the web editor stores: fontFamily, fontWeight, fontSize (px at 720p), color, strokeWidth/strokeColor, backgroundEnabled/backgroundColor/backgroundOpacity/paddingX/paddingY/borderRadius, shadow*, position (top|center|bottom), margin, subtitleWidth, textTransform, letterSpacing, revealMode (none|full|progressive|word-by-word), animationEnabled + animation (Fade|Zoom In|Zoom Out|Slide Up|Slide Down), motion*, wordStateStyles {active|past|upcoming|future: partial style}, wordHighlights {rules,customLists}, smartEmphasis, segmentColorCycle. Unknown fields are rejected. fontFamily (also inside wordStateStyles) must be a bundled font: Inter, Poppins, Oswald, Roboto, Anton, Bebas Neue, Playfair Display, Caveat, IBM Plex Mono (get_catalog {kind:'presets'} returns fonts). Caption forms: maxWordsPerCaption 1-8 (1 = one big word at a time; wins over the autoFit words cap). activeWordReflow true = a scaled active word pushes neighbours aside. wordEntrance bounce|slide-up|fade (+ wordEntranceDuration seconds) animates each word when spoken. positionMode cycle|keyword (+ positionCycle [top|center|bottom], positionKeywords [words], keywordPosition) moves captions, always inside the safe zone. captionLayout stacked = poster, one word per line with a bigger hero word (posterHeroScale 1-3). faceAvoid true = burns detect faces and move captions off them; the result returns faceAvoid.faceLayout, store it as style.faceLayout to reuse.
Full caption style JSON (same document get_catalog {kind:'presets'} returns in style; fields in get_catalog {kind:'styles'}). Replaces the whole style.

style.description: Full caption style JSON, the same document get_catalog {kind:'presets'} returns in style and the web editor stores: fontFamily, fontWeight, fontSize (px at 720p), color, strokeWidth/strokeColor, backgroundEnabled/backgroundColor/backgroundOpacity/paddingX/paddingY/borderRadius, shadow*, position (top|center|bottom), margin, subtitleWidth, textTransform, letterSpacing, revealMode (none|full|progressive|word-by-word), animationEnabled + animation (Fade|Zoom In|Zoom Out|Slide Up|Slide Down), motion*, wordStateStyles {active|past|upcoming|future: partial style}, wordHighlights {rules,customLists}, smartEmphasis, segmentColorCycle. Unknown fields are rejected. fontFamily (also inside wordStateStyles) must be a bundled font: Inter, Poppins, Oswald, Roboto, Anton, Bebas Neue, Playfair Display, Caveat, IBM Plex Mono (get_catalog {kind:'presets'} returns fonts). Caption forms: maxWordsPerCaption 1-8 (1 = one big word at a time; wins over the autoFit words cap). activeWordReflow true = a scaled active word pushes neighbours aside. wordEntrance bounce|slide-up|fade (+ wordEntranceDuration seconds) animates each word when spoken. positionMode cycle|keyword (+ positionCycle [top|center|bottom], positionKeywords [words], keywordPosition) moves captions, always inside the safe zone. captionLayout stacked = poster, one word per line with a bigger hero word (posterHeroScale 1-3). faceAvoid true = burns detect faces and move captions off them; the result returns faceAvoid.faceLayout, store it as style.faceLayout to reuse.

tags.description: Up to 8 gallery tags, max 24 characters each (e.g. bold, podcast).

type.description: custom (default) or brand. Used by create and delete.
